records.text: Thank you for your dedication. Go Max. That's a great idea. That is a fantastic idea. I really respected deeply the dedication and the persistence of Tom O'Neill in writing the book Chaos and falling down the rabbit hole and realizing nothing we were told was true and government involvement. And, you know, it's difficult to imagine someone dedicating decades of their life to finding the answers.
